claims: As of April 2026, Jeff Bezos receives an annual base salary of $81,400 from Amazon.
Jeff Bezos' annual base salary from Amazon has remained virtually unchanged since 1998.
Jeff Bezos' base salary has been consistent for nearly 30 years.
Jeff Bezos' total compensation was approximately $1.68 million in 2024.
Jeff Bezos' total compensation in 2024 was mostly for security and travel.
Jeff Bezos' wealth is over $200 billion.
Jeff Bezos owns about 8.8% to 10% of Amazon stock.
Jeff Bezos is Executive Chair of Amazon.
Jeff Bezos is the founder of Amazon.
Jeff Bezos previously stated that owning a large portion of the company provides enough incentive.
Jeff Bezos previously stated that he does not need higher cash compensation.
Jeff Bezos stepped down as CEO in 2021.
Jeff Bezos remains as Executive Chairman
